exposure: gestational age at first antepartum bleeding episode
Emergency cesarean delivery vs planned cesarean delivery
Gestational age at first antepartum bleeding
cohort: 208 singleton pregnancy patients with a confirmed diagnosis of placenta previa at the time of delivery who underwent cesarean delivery beyond 24 weeks of gestation
finding: Antepartum bleeding episode during pregnancy, first antepartum bleeding episode ≤28 weeks of gestation, and lower preoperative hemoglobin level were independent predictors of emergency cesarean delivery in pregnancies complicated with placenta previa.
